description: Far acquisition and hold, lateral/up move and hold, then return to a fixed target derived once from the initial GOOD rest screen normal using a speed-limited 40 second transition.
return_target_derivation: At preflight, compute initial monitor_control_frame origin plus 0.4 m along its local +X normal; freeze that world coordinate for the full scenario.

acceptance.acquisition_leading_face_absence: count only the initial prefix before the first valid source-stamped FACE command; require continuous fresh FACE and target use after that point through the stage end
acceptance.physical_joint_limits: every source-stamped sample, xarm6 limits from generated model
acceptance.q3_comfort: fixed holds stay within the calibrated interval with a 1 degree practical tolerance; report raw excursions and q3 extrema in every phase
acceptance.lower_rank_partial_count: report count and delta; gaze/target continuity remains the acceptance oracle
acceptance.braking_event_count: report count and delta; emergency counter must remain zero
acceptance.screen_normal_error_rationale: 1 degree practical tolerance accounts for measured RGB-D feed-forward variation; errors above 1 degree fail the gaze gate
acceptance.p_e_w_holds: only fixed hold phases; <=0.01m full-span and sliding 10s path
